name: Houzuki Masaomi
source:
Houzuki is the Special High Class Individual supervising Kenichi's examination. Despite being lame in one leg from a war injury and walking with a cane, he is an intimidating individual who unnerves even [url=/c1383]Kenichi[/url]. Relentlessly dedicated to society, he is not above manipulating anyone—even his own protégé—to produce what he perceives as the most favorable result for the future of the country.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sharin_no_Kuni,_Himawari_no_Sh%C5%8Djo]Wikipedia[/url]]
